en.topic_title: Hong Kong lawmakers pass bill to streamline Northern Metropolis development
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong lawmakers have passed a bill to streamline the multi-billion-dollar Northern Metropolis plan, with an official saying that authorities aim to implement facilitatory measures in the first quarter of next year.



This photo shows the area that will become Hong Kong’s Northern Metropolis, with Shenzhen’s skyline in the background. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
